messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Hey, {04 1f 00}, do you
want to fish with me?
{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}Let's team up! I'm all about
catching {04 1a 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Hei, {04 1f 00}, kas tahad
minuga kala püüda?
{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}Teeme koostööd! Ma tahan
püüda {04 1a 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}You should really try
fishing around a waterfall,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}They're full of negative
ions that are proven to be
positive for your skin!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Sa peaksid kindlasti
proovima kosest püüda,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Need on täis negatiivseid
ioone, mis on tõestatult
nahale positiivsed!

messages.en:
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}Hee!{01 00 00 0f 00} I'll bet you thought
I was holding a regular old
{ff 00 00 07}fishing rod{ff 00 00 00}, huh?
{07 14 00}It's actually the hippest,
hottest exercise machine
around, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}Hihi!{01 00 00 0f 00} Sa arvasid vist,
et mul on käes tavaline
{ff 00 00 07}õngeritv{ff 00 00 00}, mis?
{07 14 00}Tegelikult on see kõige
moodsam trenažöör
üldse, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Suddenly, I was struck with
an urge to catch
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1a 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
Believe it or not, my ex
and I used to while away
entire days{01 00 00 05 00} {07 09 00}fishing{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 1d 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Really? {01 00 00 0a 00}So you're collecting
fish, too, {04 1f 00}?
{01 00 00 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}?
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}Yeah,{01 00 00 0a 00} I totally agree. {01 00 00 0a 00}It's
one thing to do it and{01 00 00 05 00}
another to perfect it.
messages.et:
{07 1d 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Tõesti? {01 00 00 0a 00}Nii et sa kogud
kalu, {04 1f 00}?
{01 00 00 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}?
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}Jah,{01 00 00 0a 00} olen täiesti nõus. {01 00 00 0a 00}Üks
asi on seda teha ja{01 00 00 05 00}
teine see täiuslikuks viia.

messages.en:
{07 1d 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}What!{01 00 00 14 00} Did you catch every
kind of fish there is,
{04 1f 00}!?{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 1a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Wow!{01 00 00 14 00} A standing ovation just
pour vous!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0a 00}Hee hee! Don't I
sound so international?
messages.et:
{07 1d 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Mida!{01 00 00 14 00} Kas sa püüdsid kõik
kalaliigid, mis olemas on,
{04 1f 00}!?{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 1a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Ohoo!{01 00 00 14 00} Püstijalu aplaus
pour vous!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0a 00}Hihii! Kas ma ei
kõla väga rahvusvaheliselt?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}If you're gonna fish, you're
better off doing it in the
morning, that's for sure!
{07 19 00}That crisp morning air.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
It's so refreshing even the
fish come out to enjoy it!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kui sa kala püüad, siis
tee seda kindlasti
hommikul!
{07 19 00}See värske hommikuõhk.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
See on nii kosutav, et isegi
kalad tulevad seda nautima!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}I want to try night fishing
for a change, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

{01 00 00 05 00}{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}In the darkness of night,
I'm sure to meet that
special someone!
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Tahan vahelduseks proovida
öist kalapüüki, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

{01 00 00 05 00}{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Öö pimeduses kohtan
kindlasti seda üht
erilist inimest!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I fancy the twilight hours
and always have,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{01 00 00 05 00}{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}I always get the feeling
that a fisherboy might
come up and talk to me.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mulle meeldivad hämarad
tunnid, on alati meeldinud,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{01 00 00 05 00}{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Mul on alati tunne, et
mõni kalurpoiss võib tulla
ja minuga rääkida.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Fishing this late at night
makes my heart race{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{01 00 00 05 00}{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}It makes me feel like I'm on
an adventure or something,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Nii hilja öösel kala püüdes
lööb mu süda kiiremini{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{01 00 00 05 00}{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Tunnen end nagu oleksin
seiklusel või midagi,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}On rainy days,{01 00 00 0a 00} I can't just
sit at home quietly,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 09 00}Sitting alone thinking about
my exes is just a total
waste of time, right?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Vihmastel päevadel{01 00 00 0a 00} ei suuda
ma lihtsalt vaikselt kodus
istuda, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 09 00}Üksi istuda ja endistele
mõelda on lihtsalt
ajaraisk, eks?

messages.en:
{07 19 00}Snowy days are my favorite
days to go fishing with
other people.
{07 00 00}I just love sitting there,
the cold, soft snow falling
on my face{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 0c 00}It doesn't get more
romantic than that, huh.
{01 00 00 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Lumised päevad on mu
lemmikud, et teistega
koos kala püüda.
{07 00 00}Mulle lihtsalt meeldib seal
istuda, külm pehme lumi
näole sadamas{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 0c 00}Romantilisemaks ei
lähe, mis.
{01 00 00 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 15 00}If you really believe that
you'll catch something,
you will catch something.
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}If you go into it with a
laid-back approach, you'll
never catch anything!
{07 14 00}Tee hee, it's kinda like love
in a way, huh, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
But without the lipstick.
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Kui sa tõesti usud, et
püüad midagi,
siis sa püüadki midagi.
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Kui lähed sellele lodevalt
vastu, ei püüa sa
kunagi midagi!
{07 14 00}Hihii, see on natuke nagu
armastus, mis, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
Ainult ilma huulepulgata.

{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}
on tabamatu elukas,
{04 02 00}!
Mul pole veel ühtegi
näkkamist olnud{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}!

{07 15 00}See{01 00 00 05 00} ainult õhutab mu tuld
veel rohkem, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Näitan neile, kes on boss!
